result.instructions: Tools for smsmode, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much SMS credit do I have left on my account?"; "How many texts did we send last month and what did they cost?"; "Show my SMS campaigns and how many messages in each were delivered.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes smsmode data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smsmode_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smsmode_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smsmode_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. smsmode_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smsmode_get_balance
tools.title: Get the account balance
tools.description: The credit balance of the connected smsmode account (and sub-organisations an administrator key can see): amount and currency (negative = owed on a POST_PAY account), payment type (PRE_PAY / POST_PAY), state, monthly consumption and its limit. Good first call; check it before sending SMS. GET /commons/v1/organisations.

tools.name: smsmode_get_organisation
tools.title: Get an organisation
tools.description: Full details of one organisation: contacts, addresses, company information, balance, monthly limit and consumption. GET /commons/v1/organisations/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List messaging channels (SMS or RCS; flow TRANSACTIONAL / MARKETING / OTP) with default sender, daily and monthly limits and consumption. A channel id is needed to scope messages or consumption to one channel. GET /commons/v1/channels.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: smsmode_get_channel
tools.title: Get a channel
tools.description: Details of one channel: type, flow, default sender ID and authorized sender IDs, limits and consumption. GET /commons/v1/channels/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_list_consumptions
tools.title: List consumption statistics
tools.description: Sent-message counts and money spent per month or per day (price amount and currency), optionally for one channel. Default: monthly, the last 3 months. GET /commons/v1/consumptions.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: smsmode_get_consumption
tools.title: Get a consumption with its breakdown
tools.description: One consumption record broken down by country (mcc) or network (mccMnc) with quantity and price per sub-item, optionally with delivery statuses. GET /commons/v1/consumptions/{id}.

group_by.description: mccMnc = per network (default), mcc = per country.

annotations.title: Get a consumption with its breakdown

tools.name: smsmode_lookup_number
tools.title: Look up a phone number's network
tools.description: Country and mobile network (mcc/mnc, operator) of a phone number. Only for customers with a premium smsmode subscription and, for now, only French numbers (403 otherwise). GET /commons/v1/lookup/{msisdn}.

phone_number.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. 33600000000 or +33600000000.

annotations.title: Look up a phone number's network

tools.name: smsmode_list_messages
tools.title: List sent and received messages
tools.description: Messages with delivery status (SCHEDULED, ENROUTE, DELIVERED, UNDELIVERABLE, UNDELIVERED; status.detail names the cause), recipient, sender, text, parts and price. Default window: the last 10 days. Filter by direction (MT = sent, MO = replies received), recipient, your reference, channel or campaign. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /sms/v1/messages.

direction.description: MT = sent messages (default), MO = incoming replies.

to.description: Only messages to/from this number (international digits, e.g. 33610203040).

ref_client.description: Only messages tagged with this reference.

origin_message_id.description: Only replies to this message (direction MO is set automatically).

start_date.description: Window start (yyyy-mm-dd or yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss; default 10 days ago)

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: smsmode_get_message
tools.title: Get a message and its delivery status
tools.description: One message: delivery status and detail, delivery date, recipient network, text, parts and price. GET /sms/v1/messages/{id}.

channel_id.description: The channel the message was sent through (optional).

annotations.title: Get a message and its delivery status

tools.name: smsmode_list_campaigns
tools.title: List SMS campaigns
tools.description: Existing SMS campaigns (grouped sends) with status SCHEDULED / ONGOING / ENDED, quantity, price and per-status delivery counts. Read only: this server does not send campaigns. GET /sms/v1/campaigns.

ref_client.description: Only campaigns tagged with this reference.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: smsmode_get_campaign
tools.title: Get an SMS campaign
tools.description: One campaign: state, period, recipients count, text, price and delivery counts per status. Use smsmode_list_messages with campaign_id for its individual messages. GET /sms/v1/campaigns/{id}.

tools.name: smsmode_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS to 1-10 recipients
tools.description: WRITE, SPENDS CREDIT: sends one SMS text to 1 to 10 recipients (one message each, a batch of unit messages) and texts REAL people immediately, or at send_at. Cost: every message is charged to the account at its destination's price per SMS part (GSM7: 160 characters for 1 part, 306 for 2, 459 for 3...; UNICODE: 70, 134, 201...); the accept reply returns each message's id and status (the price may only appear later on smsmode_get_message / smsmode_list_messages; total_price is given when present). A batch can partly fail: failures lists the refused numbers, which are not charged. A message is never retried: after a timeout or error, check smsmode_list_messages (ref_client) before sending again. Max 10 recipients, no campaigns or lists. Check smsmode_get_balance first. POST /sms/v1/messages.

to.description: 1-10 recipient phone numbers in international format with country code, e.g. 33610203040 or +33610203040.

text.description: The SMS text (max 1530 characters GSM7 / 670 UNICODE; longer texts are split in parts and each part is charged).

from.description: Sender ID (max 11 characters; must be authorized for the account, else smsmode refuses). Default: the channel's sender.

stop.description: Append the legal 'STOP' unsubscribe mention (required for marketing messages with a custom sender in France).

encoding.description: GSM7 (default) or UNICODE (needed for emoji and non-Latin scripts; max 670 characters).

send_at.description: Schedule: a future date and time yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss (a time is required; at least a few minutes ahead; smsmode's local time). Omit to send now.

ref_client.description: Your reference tag (3-140 characters) to find these messages later.

tools.name: smsmode_cancel_scheduled_message
tools.title: Cancel a scheduled message
tools.description: WRITE: cancels ONE message that is still scheduled (status SCHEDULED, sent with send_at) so it is not sent; smsmode refuses messages already sent. Cannot be undone. DELETE /sms/v1/messages/{id}.

message_id.description: Id of the scheduled message (from smsmode_send_sms or smsmode_list_messages).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with smsmode
prompts.description: What you can do with smsmode here, with example requests to try.
